inherited_release_gate.note: Dev8 adds cross-build PA-route activation research helpers/tables/CLI/tests/docs. Direct package extraction, SDAT/audio, route/camera math, runtime-correct GMX animation, animated camera/field exporters, viewers, and prior real-package gates remain inherited from frozen validated checkpoints.

limitations: The final special boss-stage transition/write that supplies the reload parameter remains unresolved, so dev8 does not auto-switch procedural playback into PA-route mode.
The known retail setup directly selects camera index 0/cam01; no proven retail activation callsite selecting index 1/cam02 has been found.
Water Strider/Ultimate UFO boss-to-field mapping is strong cross-system correlation rather than one recovered literal boss->reload callsite.
Boss DAT opcode presence alone is not treated as an activation trigger.
Runtime fog-profile selection over time remains unresolved.
Camera preset word 11 remains a proven shared model/material scalar with unresolved exact virtual-setter meaning.
Instruction-level RSX/Xenos shader disassembly/translation remains future work.
The bundled Blender add-on has not been exercised inside a real Blender UI/runtime.
The project owner has not selected a license for original toolkit code.
